challenge.exploration_summary: The java-jwt library provides JWT encoding, decoding, and verification functionality. The DecodedJWT interface represents a decoded JWT token and extends Payload and Header interfaces. The JWTDecoder class implements this interface. The library already has methods to get expiration time (getExpiresAtAsInstant), not-before time (getNotBeforeAsInstant), and issued-at time (getIssuedAtAsInstant), but lacks convenient methods to check token validity directly.
challenge.feature_spec: Added six convenience methods to the DecodedJWT interface for checking token validity: isExpired(), isExpired(Instant), isNotBefore(), isNotBefore(Instant), isValid(), and isValid(Instant). These methods check the 'exp' (expiration time) and 'nbf' (not before) registered claims. If a claim is not present, it is not considered for validity. The methods throw IllegalArgumentException if a null Instant is provided.
challenge.feature_rationale: This feature belongs in the DecodedJWT interface because it's the primary interface for working with decoded JWT tokens. Users currently need to manually check getExpiresAtAsInstant() and getNotBeforeAsInstant() against the current time, which is error-prone and verbose. Adding these methods directly to the interface makes token validity checking simple and consistent across the library.
challenge.bug_description: The isValid(Instant) method incorrectly uses Instant.now() for the 'nbf' (not before) claim check when both 'exp' and 'nbf' claims are present in the token, instead of using the provided time parameter. This causes incorrect validity results when checking token validity at a specific time (past or future) for tokens that have both expiration and not-before claims. The token may appear valid when it should be invalid (or vice versa) because the nbf check uses the current system time rather than the specified verification time.

findings.description: Import statement placed before package declaration - invalid Java syntax that prevents compilation.
Malformed javadoc for getSignature() method - missing opening /** and closing */ in wrong place, causing syntax errors.

Logic bug in isValid(Instant at): when both exp and nbf claims are present, the method uses Instant.now() for the nbf check instead of the provided 'at' parameter. This causes incorrect validity results when checking at a specific time other than now.

self_review.fix_explanation: Fixed three issues in the DecodedJWT interface: (1) Moved the import statement after the package declaration to fix compilation. (2) Fixed the malformed javadoc for getSignature() method. (3) Fixed the logic bug in isValid(Instant at) by simplifying the implementation to correctly use the 'at' parameter for both exp and nbf checks, regardless of which claims are present. The new implementation: return (exp == null || !at.isAfter(exp)) && (nbf == null || !at.isBefore(nbf)); correctly handles all cases including when both claims are present, only one is present, or neither is present.
